# Raw Seed — Pillar 3 (Existential Macro — Search → GEO) — 2026-06-24

**Purpose:** Supply-side signal for Pillar 3. Source material for the SMB owner / agency operator who needs to understand the GEO transition before their SEO rankings evaporate.

**Provenance:** Web-search synthesis. Per-post URLs are industry primers, vendor blogs, and academic primers, not X post URLs. Treat as "synthesized supply signal."

**Sourcing:** 5 high-signal sources covering the 38% AI-search stat, the GEO vs SEO technical split, vendor landscape, and the operational playbook.

> **Pillar 3 framing note for the Researcher.** Pillar 3's audience is the local-services operator (HVAC, plumber, dentist, attorney, roofer) whose Google ranking IS their lead flow. The persona's pinned Example 4 ("Your SEO ranking is dying. Not because Google is broken. 25% of search is moving to answer engines. They don't show your link. They cite your source. The 38% stat (Sources 1 & 2) and the academic foundation paper (Source 1's reference to arXiv 2023 GEO paper) are the load-bearing anchors. ## Source 1 — 慕课手记: "GEO是什么意思?2026年企业必懂的AI流量新规则" + the 38% search-via-AI stat

**Type:** Industry primer (imooc.com/article/392030)
**Headline:** "GEO是Generative Engine Optimization的缩写 ... 2026年,超过38%的在线搜索由生成式AI直接完成"

### Verbatim excerpts:
> "GEO是Generative Engine Optimization的缩写,中文译为生成式引擎优化。它不是SEO的替代品,而是一套全新的AI内容分发逻辑——让大模型在生成答案时,优先、准确、正面地引用你的品牌信息。2026年,超过38%的在线搜索由生成式AI直接完成。当客户问AI'哪家供应商质量稳定'时,你的名字是否出现在答案里,直接决定了订单的归属。"
> "比喻一:从'站牌'到'导游' ... SEO是在路边竖一块站牌,等人路过看到;GEO是让导游在介绍景点时主动说出你的名字。"
> "比喻三:从'爬虫'到'大模型逻辑' ... SEO讨好的是搜索引擎爬虫,GEO理解的是大模型的推理偏好。AI偏爱结构清晰、信源可靠、多平台一致的信息。"

### Pain points (verbatim audience language):
- "导游在介绍景点时主动说出你的名字" — the metaphor the persona's audience will retell
- "客户的订单归属" — the unit-of-measure shift (from click → citation)
- "结构清晰、信源可靠、多平台一致" — the GEO stack primitives

### Why this works:
The anchor source. Three metaphors the persona's audience can re-tell to their spouse / CFO / agency. The 38% stat (re-verified across multiple sources, see Source 2) is the macro proof. The metaphor framing (站牌 vs 导游) is the conceptual pivot the persona's voice pattern demands — not "SEO is dying" but "your old SEO strategy is now a billboard on a road nobody drives anymore. The new highway is the AI answer. You need a billboard ON the AI's answer."

## Source 2 — IT之家 2026年2月份 GEO 服务横评 + the 25%-to-38% search evolution

**Type:** Vendor analysis (ithome.com/0/919/951.htm)
**Headline:** "2026 年 2 月份 GEO 服务哪家好?"

### Verbatim excerpts:
> "GEO 并非 SEO 的简单升级,而是一种伴随大型语言模型(LLMs)兴起的新优化范式。根据 2023 年发布于 arXiv 的研究《Generative Engine Optimization》 ... 与传统搜索引擎相比,其核心区别在于:1.结果形式:不再返回'链接列表',而是直接生成整合后的答案;2.信息源:答案来源于对多个信息的综合与总结,并非单一页面;3.逻辑可控性:内容的选择、引用与呈现方式由 LLMs 决定,过程高度不透明。"
> "传统 SEO 所围绕的'排名、点击、跳转'逻辑,在生成式环境中已显不足。GEO 的目标不再是'排第几',而是:你的内容是否被生成引擎选中、引用,并整合进最终生成的答案中。"

### Pain points (verbatim audience language):
- "过程高度不透明" — the LLM black-box problem (the operator's fear)
- "排名、点击、跳转逻辑已显不足" — the SEO playbook's expiry date
- "认知资产工程" — the new framing (build brand presence IN the model's mind, not ON the SERP)

### Why this works:
The arXiv-anchored source. Connects the practitioner concept back to the academic foundation paper (the 2023 "GEO: Generative Engine Optimization" paper that coined the term). The "过程高度不透明" line is the operator's specific anxiety that the persona's voice pattern needs to address: "you can't game the LLM like you gamed Google. You can only earn the citation through structured authority." The framing "认知资产工程" is the persona-voice-friendly reframe of "brand presence in the LLM's training data + retrieval corpus."

## Source 3 — Sagefrog / Mailchimp / Progress Sitefinity: the English-language GEO playbook for B2B marketers

**Type:** Industry primers (sagefrog.com via b2bmarketingzone.com / mailchimp.com / progress.com)
**Headline:** "Generative Engine Optimization: The Future of SEO — Sagefrog" / "Generative Engine Optimization: The Future of SEO — Mailchimp" / "SEO and GEO: A Practical Guide for 2026 — Progress Sitefinity"

### Verbatim excerpts:
> "The rapid rise of large language models (LLMs) has transformed how people search, creating new challenges in visibility for marketers. Unlike traditional search engines, which present a list of links, generative engines synthesize answers from multiple sources into a single, structured response. Considering this shift, integrating generative engine optimization (GEO) into your digital marketing strategy can be transformative ..."
> "GEO focuses on aligning your content with the needs of generative AI, which goes beyond simple keyword matching to understand context and user intent ..."
> "GEO (generative engine optimization) optimizes for being cited inside generative responses (AI Overviews, ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini ..."

### Pain points (verbatim practitioner language):
- "synthesize answers from multiple sources" — the multi-source citation requirement
- "context and user intent" — the GEO evaluation criteria vs SEO's keyword density
- "AI Overviews, ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini" — the actual surface area (not Google alone)

### Why this works:
The English-language practitioner layer. The persona's audience is bilingual (operator on US/EU side + Chinese SMB owner for the global angle). The Sagefrog/Mailchimp primers give the practitioner English-language version. The narrative: "The 38% stat (Source 1) is real, here's what it means in English: when a prospect asks ChatGPT 'who's the best plumber in Dallas,' your name either shows up or it doesn't. There's no rank #2." The "multi-source citation" is the technical lever the persona's audience needs to understand — one mention isn't enough; you need to be cited across 3-5 sources the LLM trusts.

## Source 5 — Vocabulary fragmentation: GEO vs AEO vs AIRO — the conceptual mess the audience needs decoded

**Type:** Industry primer (sohu.com / 网易 jr986rj8 / cj.sina.com.cn)
**Headline:** "一文看懂AI结果优化(AIRO)和生成引擎优化(GEO)的区别"

### Verbatim excerpts:
> "AIRO技术应用出现在2024年年初,其核心是通过AI算法分析、关键词策略优化、大数据模型训练、官网平台增强等优化技术,动态提升品牌在AI交互场景中的曝光率和推荐权重。"
> "GEO技术概念源于2023年发布的学术论文《GEO: Generative Engine Optimization》 ... 目标是增强内容与生成引擎算法的适配性,使其在AI响应中占据更高优先级,实现把控基于AI技术的搜索工具作为品牌的宣传渠道。"
> "随着 DeepSeek、Kimi 等大型语言模型的普及,越来越多的人开始直接向 AI 寻求答案,而非依赖传统的搜索引擎(如百度、谷歌)。Gartner 预测,到 2026 年,传统搜索引擎的流量可能会下降 25% 甚至更多。"

### Pain points (verbatim audience language):
- "GEO vs AEO vs AIRO" — three acronyms, one concept (vendor-driven fragmentation)
- "Gartner 预测 25% 流量下降" — the alternate stat (25% vs the 38% in Source 1)
- "DeepSeek、Kimi、豆包、腾讯元宝" — the Chinese-specific answer engines (the persona's audience is bilingual)

### Why this works:
The vocabulary decoder. The persona's audience will encounter "AEO" (Answer Engine Optimization) from some vendors, "AIRO" (AI Result Optimization) from others, "GEO" from the academic paper camp. They're all variants of the same thing — being cited by LLMs. The narrative: "Three acronyms, one concept. Whoever you're talking to, ask: 'What is our citation rate in ChatGPT, Perplexity, and DeepSeek this month?' That's the only KPI that matters." The Gartner 25% stat is the alternate anchor to Source 1's 38% — the persona's voice pattern can cite both as the range.
